what: The full-width wordmark is light over the first section (photo). Once past the line where the first section scrolls up and gets cut, the same spot appears to switch to a dark wordmark, which then stays pinned at screen center for 170vh and scrolls up. Scroll itself is the boundary, so there is no curve.

options.offset: Distance (px) to move out of the way downward from vertical center, default 0 — original is half the small header height (about 30)
options.hold: Height (vh) of the panel where dark text sticks, default 170 — original is 200 when the width is wide
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: First section (photo panel) — the part sets clip-path: inset(0) and z-index. Height is at least one screen
options.[data-fx-part=trail]: Panel right after the first page — the part pulls it up by -100vh
options.[data-fx-part=back]: Dark text (sticky) inside the trail — the front is aligned to this text’s horizontal position and width

note: Because front is fixed, if the first slide has an ancestor with transform or filter it attaches to that ancestor instead of the screen — don’t use it inside such a panel

from.where: index.html .top-hero (.top-hero__logo fixed) → .top-logo (.top-logo__logo sticky). Original top-hero clip-path:inset(0), top-logo 170vh/200vh, margin-top -100vh.
